import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
lab_dum = pd.get_dummies(d['lab'], prefix='lab', drop_first=True).astype(float)
for c in cands:
    sub = d.dropna(subset=[c])
    X = pd.concat([sub[[c]].astype(float), lab_dum.loc[sub.index]], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(sub['tensile_mpa'], X).fit()
    print(f"{c:14s} coef={m.params[c]: .4f} se={m.bse[c]:.4f} t={m.tvalues[c]: .3f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f}")
